note: Sonoma County Regional Parks campground in oak grassland south of Spring Lake's dam in Santa Rosa, entered from Newanga Avenue. Three sites have sleeping cabins and there is a group site. The park has a paved 2.3-mile loop trail around the lake, electric-only boating, and a swimming lagoon with a summer water park. --Claude
summary: Sonoma County park and camping-policy pages, park map, OSM and imagery read. $41, no hookups, 31 sites to 31 ft, showers, dump, 10-night max, reservations required, year-round. Not waterfront kept. Re-pin ~770 m from the Violetti Rd lagoon entrance to the campground off Newanga Ave.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront agrees, but for a different reason than the stored evidence (which describes the Violetti end): the loops sit south of the South Saddle Dam, ~150 m from the shore over the dam berm.
